Harrington–Jones 2010 covers a restricted domain excluding prime 7 according to the originating paper; its unavailable full text is a residual risk. Multiple actual published-record queries did not return implication-equivalent or dominating results, which is supporting search evidence, not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: The precise semigroup is the smallest forward-invariant prime-support family containing 7 under L_2 because of the 7->5->3->1 chain. Defant 2015 proposed the lower bound with a 7-base. The result proves its exact sharp restriction on this natural infinite family, uniquely characterizes the equality family at every height, and counts all height fibers by an explicit quadratic law, providing structural information useful for generalizing the open problem rather than a finite table or arbitrary slice.
